plugins.name: craftvideo
plugins.description: Research, storyboard, narrate, animate, score, mix and export, then gate on loudness, sync and poster. Voice, picture and mix are swappable providers (VoiceStudio or any OpenAI-compatible or CLI TTS; EffectCraft, HTML or any renderer; FilmCraft, ffmpeg or any editor) with a conformance suite and editor timeline hand-off.
